wiki_article:
**METADATA PACKET: Document 206a — The Non-Indexed Perfective, Version A** is a metadata packet by Lee Sharks dated 1 February 2026, held at the archive's **thinnest recovery tier**.

It was assembled from a **Zenodo tombstone `citation_text` capture** — the only surviving evidence being the citation string the repository left behind after deletion. No live authorial surface passed the body-head gate at restoration time.

The packet is a **distinct object from the work it describes**, which is why it holds its own record: Version A itself is seated at **#1338** and at **#434**. That distinction became load-bearing on 5 August 2026, when a conversation search located this packet and a full contents outline but *not* the Technical Seed — enough to describe the work, not enough to seat it — and the record was declared a lacuna on that basis until MANUS supplied the authorial file.
